addition.item: Added automatic metadata language mode to keep output in the same language as the article content.
Added custom metadata language option for multilingual websites.

change.item: Improved prompt instructions to reduce mixed-language output in meta descriptions and keywords.
Updated language handling so non-Turkish content no longer falls back to English by default.
Improved support for Joomla 6 multilingual editorial workflows.

fix.item: Fixed an issue where Croatian articles could generate mostly English meta descriptions.
Fixed an issue where generated keywords could be mixed between Croatian and English.
Fixed language handling behavior for non-English and non-Turkish article content.

note.item: For Croatian websites, set Metadata language to Croatian or Automatic - same as article content.
For multilingual websites, the Automatic - same as article content option is recommended.
This is still an early 0.x release, but it includes an important improvement for real-world multilingual publishing workflows.

fix.item: Added update server support to the plugin manifest.
Added changelog URL support to the plugin manifest.
Added a GPL-compatible license header to the main plugin class.
Improved Turkish administrator translations for the API key field and About tab.
Renamed the basic settings fieldset label to Plugin Settings.

note.item: Update the GitHub URLs if you use a different repository name or release path.
The checksum values in update.xml match the ZIP package generated for version 0.1.6.

addition.item: Added a new About fieldset to the plugin configuration.
Added usage notes and support information to the plugin settings screen.
